implementation.qualified_inputs: Exact-path/bytes/SHA original observation and listed source references are re-read; explicit fixed-scope SIM energy/capability estimates fill only missing inputs.
implementation.source_identity_scope: Content binding and stat identity stable inside each read window; not a retained inode identity across calls, independent packet decoder, or sender authentication.
implementation.compilation: Current-time requalification returns the new budget receipt alongside the shared v2 held-Mission draft. Exact context/task/geometry/policy/profile/runtime/clock/deadline binding; MR SIM only.
implementation.resource_adjustment: Only explicitly bound v2 MR SURVEY with no detection, RETURN and geofence constraints may omit an active perception engine; camera/map/DEM/GPS/geofence/energy/wind gates remain.
implementation.budget: (E - receive_age) * usable_fraction - receive_age * (1 - usable_fraction) = E * usable_fraction - receive_age. Return reserve deducted once; original sampled battery unchanged.
implementation.transport: INT upload/readback parameterize and validate actual GCS sender identity; 255/190 accepted only with matching MAVLink source, foreign/broadcast never advance. Legacy 250/191 remains compatible.

independent_review.scope: pure-memory reference energy ledger, scope and v1 compatibility

corrected_findings: Recompute remaining endurance at current compilation time rather than original qualification time.
Deduct full receive age without proportionally shrinking the reserved energy.
Low-level modeled-budget compilation cannot reuse an older qualification time, even inside the observation TTL.

reserve_regression_reproduced_before_ass.meaning: Old headroom formula fails under corrected accounting; preserved as development test failure, not runtime evidence.

retained_index_maintenance_tests.scope: retained-files/index/software checks; not external runtime reexecution

document_and_parity_regressions.scope: document/source parity/retained matrix/index regression tests, no runtime reexecution

pretrained_research.purpose: Primary-source checkpoint/action/resource/license audit; not flight quality, downloaded weight identity or hardware admission.

remaining_gates: Fresh actual observation and owned-container inspection in the same new session/clock.
Reviewed and declared exact-scope SIM energy/capability source for the actual scenario.
Fresh camera/geofence sources, verified EKF/map origin, complete 3-D collision/route-clearance review including takeoff/return/landing and uncertainty margins.
Narrow Mission sender facade owned by unique RX/send worker and persisted source-filtered response consumer.
Real validation report, explicit disposable-SIM intent/grant, persistent upload/readback/commit/permit, normal preflight/ARM and actual motion.
Actual command/settled attitude/displacement/post-action-image intervals reviewed before new action/history training.
Independent scene holdout, shared model deployment identity, Jetson/HIL/REAL/outdoor GNSS and final release gates.

current_source_parity.scope: current source computation and retained-file audit only; not a current external SIM/HIL/REAL rerun
